title: Active-status-but-expired vacancy lost its draft-sweep pin in the test rewrite (documented lifecycle-outage edge untested)
evidence:
Removed by the diff: "-  // Still-active status but closes_at already passed (auto-close window)…
-  let assert Ok(past_id) = test_db.seed_vacancy(db, landlord_id, True)
-  let _ = seed_draft_with_token(db, past_id, "tok-past")". In the rewritten suite every expired-closes_at case goes through auto_close_with_closes_at (lines 590-594: "SET status = 'closed', closed_via = 'auto',
         closes_at = now() - interval '" <> ago <> "'"), so status is always 'closed'. The SQL comment documents the untested state (delete_expired_application_drafts.sql:16-19): "--     closes_at < now()). Edge, accepted: a vacancy that sits
--     active-but-expired for >7 days (lifecycle job down AND no landlord
--     dashboard visit to trigger the request-time auto-close) loses its
--     drafts while still technically extendable".
detail: Old test pinned deletion for a still-active vacancy with closes_at past (request-time auto-close window). The rewrite only exercises pre-closed rows; neither the in-grace survival (expired 3d, status active) nor the documented >7d-outage deletion of an active-but-expired vacancy is pinned.
recommended_fix: Add two cases to retention_sweep_grace test: vacancy left status='active' with closes_at 3d past (draft survives) and 8d past (draft swept via time-based branch through the lifecycle-then-sweep pass).

title: Exact 7-day grace threshold unpinned — any constant in (3d, 8d] passes the new tests
evidence:
Predicate under test (lines 45-48): "AND COALESCE(v.closed_notified_at, v.closes_at)
          <= now() - interval '7 days'
    )
    OR v.closes_at <= now() - interval '7 days'". Test offsets (draft_integration_test.gleam): "let assert Ok(_) = close_vacancy_manual(db, manual_recent_id, "3 days")", "let assert Ok(_) = close_vacancy_manual(db, manual_old_id, "8 days")", "let assert Ok(_) = auto_close_with_closes_at(db, time_recent_id, "3 days")", "let assert Ok(_) = auto_close_with_closes_at(db, time_old_id, "8 days")"; the other two new tests use only "1 day".
detail: All assertions use 1/3/8-day offsets, so a regression of the constant to 6 or 8 days still satisfies every assertion (3d survives, 8d deletes at equality). The spec's core parameter — exactly 7 days — has no boundary pin on either side.
recommended_fix: Add boundary cases bracketing the threshold, e.g. closes_at 6 days 23 hours past (survives) and 7 days 1 hour past (deleted), for at least one branch.

title: Documented archived-and-long-expired sweep behavior has no test pin
evidence:
Comment (lines 33-36): "-- archived vacancies follow the same rules (auto-close paths exclude
-- archived rows, but the time-based branch still sweeps an
-- archived-and-long-expired vacancy's drafts). Documented honestly here". The only archived case seeds a future closes_at (test_db.gleam:541): "SELECT $1::uuid, 'Archived Property', '789 Main St', 'Dublin', 'Dublin', 150000, 'active', true, code.val, 'apply-' || code.val || '@app.righttenantry.ie', NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day', 'righttenantry.ie'", and the test asserts survival: "draft_field(db, archived_id, "continue_token")
  |> should.equal("tok-archived")".
detail: The amended SQL comment newly documents that an archived vacancy with closes_at >7d past still loses drafts to the time-based branch, but the suite only pins archived+unexpired survival; the archived+expired deletion path is untested (pre-existing behavior, disclosed, but now explicitly documented).
recommended_fix: Add one case: archived vacancy with closes_at 8 days past and a seeded draft; assert the sweep deletes it, pinning the documented semantics.
